question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Forefront**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Forefront **means the leading or most important position or part. (अग्रणी या सबसे महत्वपूर्ण पद या भाग)

 
 
• **Example**: *The new technology brought the company to the forefront of the industry, leading to increased recognition and success.*
 
 
 
• In this context, "forefront" signifies that India is at the forefront of the world's most promising renewable energy sectors.
 
• So, "**forefront**" is the appropriate word to convey that India is at the leading edge, occupying a prominent position in the world's most promising renewable energy sectors due to strong government support and a favourable economic environment.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Background: **The part of a scene or picture that is farthest from the viewer; the context or setting of an event. (किसी दृश्य या चित्र का वह भाग जो दर्शक से सबसे दूर हो; किसी घटना का संदर्भ या सेटिंग)
 
• **Forward: **In the direction one is facing or moving; toward the front; promoting progress. (जिस दिशा में कोई मुख कर रहा है या आगे बढ़ रहा है; सामने की ओर; प्रगति को बढ़ावा देना)
 
• **Rear: **The back part or section; to bring up or nurture. (पिछला भाग या भाग; पालन-पोषण या पालन-पोषण करना)
